frontier_selector.why: The noncontrast CT of the head revealed a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection, which is specific evidence for Chronic Subdural Hematoma.

support_spans: Noncontrast CT of the head revealed a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection over the left frontoparietal convexity with areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity, measuring 15 mm in width with a 13-mm midline shift
